head: 49d93d2a
sequenceNote: 1) Refresh feature map (core/content/util) for client+server, 2) tighten worldgen hydrology (caves/rivers/lakes) + map-control parity, 3) validate protobuf packet bindings, 4) push docs/builds.

server.name: world-map-control-parity
server.notes: Keep streamed profile hash aligned with JSON world config; share hydrology/cave tuning across server/client previews; enforce seam-safe elevation and water-level constraints.

server.name: protocol-registry-validation
server.notes: Verify generated EnhancedMinecraft DTOs and handler bindings on startup; surface missing packet coverage and stale descriptor loads.

client.name: world-map-preview-parity
client.notes: Unity preview reuses server hydrology/cave params with gradient stability and lake smoothing; reloads profile JSON hash.

client.name: protocol-client-bindings
client.notes: Ensure client protobuf DTO references mirror SharedProtocol registry and server dispatch; guard against stale generated assemblies.

server.name: cave-river-lake-coherence
server.notes: Hydrology-driven carving with seam-aware smoothing, riparian plugs, and outflow blending; keeps subterranean water aligned with rivers and basins.

client.name: map-visualization
client.notes: Display stabilized rivers/lakes/caves from control profile; mirror erosion/outflow tuning and hydrology smoothing in preview chunks.

server.name: data-driven-config-refresh
server.notes: JSON-backed config loader with checksum logging; feeds world map control generation and hydrology/lake/cave thresholds.

client.name: streaming-profile-hotload
client.notes: Hot-reloads map-control JSON and resets preview generator when hash/signature changes; ensures data-driven parameters remain synced.
